steps.purpose: Refuse execution before the release time; run this first and stop on any failure.
steps.command: python3 -c 'from datetime import datetime; assert datetime.now().astimezone() >= datetime.fromisoformat("2026-11-06T18:27:00-05:00"), "full execution is DEFERRED"'

steps.purpose: Prepare a separate clean baseline at the recorded source identity; reuse it only if this identity and cleanliness still match.
Build both compilers from their preserved seeds on the same host, with current build receipts.
steps.command: nice -n 10 env JOBS=2 make -C ../sources/base build && nice -n 10 env JOBS=2 make build

steps.purpose: Emit all exact generated sizes and measure five self emits per compiler; retain sources, IR, receipts, hashes, timing and per-child RSS outside the checkout.
Require both original numerical verdicts; a missing or partial report never passes.
steps.command: python3 -c 'import json; r=json.load(open("../evidence/deferred/bench.json")); assert [p["lines"] for p in r["programs"]] == [10000,100000,1000000]; assert r["full_scale_verdict"] == r["self_compile_timing_verdict"] == "PASS"; assert r["scale_ratio"] <= 15 and r["self_ratio"] <= 1.10; assert all(len(r["self_compile"][k]["runs"]) == 5 for k in ("base","candidate"))'
